summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares. The company purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 105.4485 pence per share (range 104.55–106.00 pence). These purchases are part of the existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the outstanding share count. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory timeline is disclosed. This is a routine market purchase under the buyback programme. The risk-arb angle is nil; the filing merely records a capital return to shareholders via periodic open-market repurchases.
